name: Chijoku no Uzu ~Nerawareta Futari no Niizuma~
original_name: 恥辱の渦～狙われた二人の新妻～
source:
Kouji's older brother suggests they play a "game".
The game is to switch wives, and see if anyone can tell the difference. So they switch wives, and have an altogether different kind of sex.
With this game as the incentive, both married couples spiral into corruption, which is is depicted in radical ways!

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE038254.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
浩二的哥哥提议玩一场“游戏”。
规则是两对夫妻交换妻子，看看有没有人能够察觉异样。于是他们交换了伴侣，也体验了与以往完全不同的性爱。
以这场游戏为契机，两对夫妻双双陷入堕落的螺旋。本作将以激进露骨的方式描绘这一过程！
